title: wipe with objects: the edges sweep over the registered stills (every border aligned at every frame), half-transparent overlap, and four buildings on the summer base (the tower block, the yellow house, the right-hand apartment block, the blocks at the left skyline) take the coming season 4 frames before its sheet reaches them and keep it 14 frames after it leaves (GrabCut mattes feathered 10 px, Poisson plates)
gag: Three seasons from one balcony in Ivano-Frankivsk (his order: 1 summer, 2 early autumn, 3 late autumn). Summer holds; the two other seasons slide in from opposite corners along a 62° diagonal, pass each other over summer, and leave; summer remains, so the clip loops. The output is the centre 75 % of the registered canvas (3600 px prep), so a drifting picture never runs out of pixels.
